rows.clause: the cost of staying current is proportional to what changed: an edit to one item recomputes that item's record and its sections, and nothing else
rows.falsified_by: any work.*.*.done delta outside the edited item's record and embed stages, or a record-stage delta other than one

rows.clause: a resync that moves signals without changing bytes runs its verification and recomputes nothing downstream of it
rows.falsified_by: any work.*.*.done delta after an identical-bytes resync, or a resync that moves no work.*.resync.noop counter at all — the second being a run that verified nothing rather than one that recomputed nothing

rows.clause: two server processes on one data directory both answer queries without corrupting the index
rows.falsified_by: either process failing to answer while the other is live, or an index that a third process cannot read after both have stopped

rows.clause: two server processes on one data directory do not do the same work twice
rows.falsified_by: any work.*.*.done counter moving when a second process joins a data directory whose work had already settled

rows.clause: an index written under a different schema version ends up serving, in either direction, without anyone deleting files by hand
rows.falsified_by: a foreign-stamped index that answers nothing after a restart, or one that only comes back after a file is removed by hand
